verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official SDK path for one part of the suite: the mppx SDK is published on npm, the MPP docs offer a Node language variant, and Stripe's llms.txt points agents to Stripe packages on npm. There is no documented language-SDK coverage for the core Agentic Commerce Suite flows (catalog feeds, checkout, SPT issuance), and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented official SDKs (with language matrix) for ACS checkout, catalog and SPT APIs, an OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
